summary: Reproduced the BM16 inline A4W4 numerical failure and attributed it to an invalid FP32 reference input: the actual kernel consumes BF16. The narrow repair makes the independent MXFP4 reference quantize those exact BF16 values. Exact MiniMax dimensions passed for inline SiLU and SwiGLU-OAI at 1/2/4/16/32/256 tokens, while packed BM32 remains passing and BM64 remains explicitly xfailed.
